[All pages](README.md).

### [`hero-inline-search-panel.tsx`](../../components/search/hero-inline-search-panel.tsx)

- `default (HeroInlineSearchPanel)` _component_: Desktop-only in-place hero search: the input stays in the hero and the results FLOAT below it — an absolutely positioned dropdown that expands downward over the page.

### [`hero-inline-search.tsx`](../../components/search/hero-inline-search.tsx)

- `HeroInlineSearch` _component_: The hero search: in-place floating results on desktop, palette popup on mobile.

### [`hero-search-field.tsx`](../../components/search/hero-search-field.tsx)

- `HeroSearchShell` _component_: The hero search field before the search chunk exists: a REAL input, not a placeholder div.
- `HERO_SEARCH_INPUT_CLASS` _const_: Shared look of the hero search input — the lazy panel's real input mirrors these classes.

### [`search-bar.tsx`](../../components/search/search-bar.tsx)

- `SearchCommand` _component_: Trigger for the site search palette, as a button, an input or the hero field. Loads the dialog on first open; with `isGlobal`, Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles it.

### [`search-browse-group.tsx`](../../components/search/search-browse-group.tsx)

- `SearchBrowseGroup` _component_: The pre-query list: nearby parks, the rides of the park the visitor is standing in, or the popular parks when neither is available.

### [`search-dialog.tsx`](../../components/search/search-dialog.tsx)

- `default (SearchDialog)` _component_: The heavy search palette: cmdk + live result/glossary/nearby queries + result rendering.

### [`search-result-groups.tsx`](../../components/search/search-result-groups.tsx)

- `SearchResultGroups` _component_: The category groups of a search result set (parks/attractions/shows/restaurants/locations + glossary), ordered by best match score.

### [`search-result-items.tsx`](../../components/search/search-result-items.tsx)

- `SearchResultRow` _component_: A single park/attraction/show/restaurant/location result row.
- `GlossaryResultItem` _component_: A single glossary term result row (shared by the glossary-only and mixed-results branches).

### [`search-results-panel.tsx`](../../components/search/search-results-panel.tsx)

- `SearchResultsPanel` _component_: The body of both search surfaces — the hero's floating dropdown and the header's palette: skeleton → results (or glossary-only, or "no results") once a query runs, and the browse list before that. Only the shell around it differs.

### [`search-skeleton-list.tsx`](../../components/search/search-skeleton-list.tsx)

- `SearchSkeletonList` _component_: Heading + rows, i.e. everything inside a pending dropdown above its footer.
- `HERO_SKELETON_ROW_CLASS` _const_: Hero row padding — matches `[&_[cmdk-item]]:py-2.5` on that panel's cmdk root at every width (the `sm:` half is what keeps the palette's `sm:py-3.5` default from winning back).
